verdict.rationale: Omnara's pricing page states it is free to self-host and open source under Apache 2.0, and its GitHub README refers to self-hosted deployments backed by Postgres. Community questions about data going to a third party are open questions, not concrete contradictions. Missing for 10: self-hosting installation and deployment docs (e.g. Docker or infrastructure requirements), clarity on whether every hosted feature is included in the self-hosted build, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0.
